pageProps.title: The Traffic Officer's Night
pageProps.review: Keigo Higashino's novel The Traffic Officer's Night sharply explores human selfishness and moral responsibility through the tragedies caused by everyday traffic violations, throwing a heavy warning to our society.
pageProps.description: Are you the perpetrator or the victim behind the wheel?
pageProps.content:
## Review This work uses the extremely common subject of traffic violations as a microscope to reveal human selfishness, responsibility, and the unfillable gap between legal justice and moral justice.
This work consists of six short stories and shows the process of how a ```minor traffic violation``` is amplified into an irreversible tragedy.
In particular, the first story, Angel's Ears, shows how a case is distorted by social prejudice.
The self-justification of ```everyone does it``` is the psychological root of all tragedies. It's a work that acts as a warning light for all of us.
